title: gleichenia circinnata var. rupestris
intro: Gleichenia circinnata var. rupestris, commonly known as Rock Stag's-horn Fern, is a species of fern in the family Gleicheniaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving respiratory issues, and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Rock Stag's-horn Fern include its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, glycosides, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to confirm its full potential.
